msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since you have completed the referral theory and pool sessions, the *Open Water Referral Course* is the right option. Please bring your referral paperwork signed by a PADI instructor.

The refresher is booked as a Dive Mini Course. The two-day referral course requires an overnight stay on the islands, and accommodation isn’t included.

The referred course requires a PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; the plan is the Open Water Referral Course, not a regular dive trip.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: Gracias - y en pesos? Para colombianos?

msg: Amigo el precio que está allí es en dólares o pesos colombianos
reply: ¡Claro, amigo! El precio puede aparecer en las dos monedas: si eres colombiano o residente en Colombia, pagas en pesos colombianos (COP); si no, en dólares estadounidenses (USD). El valor es el mismo, solo cambia la moneda. ¿Eres colombiano o residente en Colombia?

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?
reply:
For the most convenient access, I’d recommend *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande—both are our dive bases, and pick-up is direct. Other nearby hotels with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Pick-up arrangements can vary by hotel, and accommodation is booked directly with the hotel.

If you’re staying on the islands, pick-up and drop-off are at your hotel if it has maritime access.

Would you like me to share the booking links once you’ve chosen your dates?

msg: Great. We will book diving with you on the website and will book our hotel on the island . Hope you are operating on Easter Sunday? We want to dive on April 5 and 6. How do we book/pay for the $50 refresher course?
reply:
Yes—we operate every day except December 25 and January 1, so Easter Sunday is included. Your April 5–6 dates can be selected in the booking calendar; trips may be suspended only if weather conditions are adverse.

The refresher is booked as the *Dive Mini Course*. Since you’ll be staying on the islands, it’s *$134 USD per person online* (the online price; lunch isn’t included). Book it here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

The refresher is a one-day activity, so select its date separately from the two-day Open Water Referral Course. You’ll pay through the website during booking. The referral course is booked separately, and you’ll need your referral paperwork signed by a PADI instructor. Would you like its booking link too?
